result.stdout:
XtudioPdf

  xtudiopdf open <file.pdfx> [--build] [--no-browser] [--port 5000] [--editor]
      Opens the designer on a template. --build compiles the project first to read its DTOs.
      --editor is for the VS Code / Visual Studio extensions: it does not open the browser, prints
      XTUDIOPDF_URL=<address> and exits when the editor closes standard input.

  xtudiopdf new <Name> [--model QuoteDto] [--size a4|ticket80] [--folder Reports | --in <folder>]
      Creates <Name>.pdfx, its sample data, the DTO and the report class in Reports/ (or in <folder>).

  xtudiopdf setup-vs
      How to open .pdfx files with a double click from Visual Studio.

  --lang en|es   Message language (defaults to the one you chose in the designer).
